Resolution repealing and replacing to revise the Agricultural Enhancement Council Resolution.

Memorandum of Agreement for use to contract with Affiliated Personnel in anticipation of being designated by the State of Florida as a Florida Urban Search and Rescue Task Force.
Potential amendments to the BCC Rules of Procedure.

source_note: Items and titles transcribed from the official agenda (table of contents or order of business). Agendas list what was scheduled, not what was decided; votes are not in agendas.
